ng-orbit is a headless Angular UI library for tables, wizards, and ready-to-install renderer packages.

Primary audience:
- Angular consumers who want reusable state and contracts without losing UI ownership
- AI agents that need a short, stable chooser for install paths, ownership boundaries, and public APIs

Consumer-ready packages:
- @ng-orbit/notify -> headless notification service for app-wide toasts, confirms, and blocking action flows
- @ng-orbit/notify-render-plain -> semantic reference renderer for @ng-orbit/notify
- @ng-orbit/table -> headless table controller for query intent, selection, and rendering contracts
- @ng-orbit/wizard -> headless wizard controller for navigation, validity, and completion flows
- @ng-orbit/wizard-kit -> Angular forms validity bridge for @ng-orbit/wizard
- @ng-orbit/table-render-plain -> semantic reference renderer for @ng-orbit/table
- @ng-orbit/table-render-material -> Angular Material renderer for @ng-orbit/table
- @ng-orbit/table-render-daisy -> DaisyUI and Tailwind renderer for @ng-orbit/table
- @ng-orbit/wizard-render-material -> Angular Material renderer for @ng-orbit/wizard
- @ng-orbit/wizard-render-daisy -> DaisyUI and Tailwind renderer for @ng-orbit/wizard

Package chooser:
- App-wide notifications and confirms:
  - pnpm add @ng-orbit/notify @ng-orbit/notify-render-plain
- Product-owned server-driven table UI:
  - pnpm add @ng-orbit/table
- Fastest semantic table UI:
  - pnpm add @ng-orbit/table @ng-orbit/table-render-plain
- Angular Material table:
  - pnpm add @ng-orbit/table @ng-orbit/table-render-material @angular/material @angular/cdk @angular/animations
- DaisyUI/Tailwind table:
  - pnpm add @ng-orbit/table @ng-orbit/table-render-daisy
- Product-owned wizard with Angular forms:
  - pnpm add @ng-orbit/wizard @ng-orbit/wizard-kit
- Angular Material wizard:
  - pnpm add @ng-orbit/wizard @ng-orbit/wizard-kit @ng-orbit/wizard-render-material @angular/material @angular/cdk @angular/animations
- DaisyUI/Tailwind wizard:
  - pnpm add @ng-orbit/wizard @ng-orbit/wizard-kit @ng-orbit/wizard-render-daisy

Mental model:
- core or headless packages own state, commands, events, and stable contracts
- kits are thin helpers, not full renderers
- renderers are ready-to-install UI packages for specific visual stacks
- adapters are the integration layer between headless controllers and product UI
- there is no published adapter-* package family today

Ownership rules:
- ng-orbit does not fetch data
- ng-orbit does not own consumer forms
- ng-orbit does not own submission side effects
- ng-orbit does not own business sorting, filtering, or validation rules
- consumers own backend mapping, persistence, analytics, routing, and final layout

AI consumption rules:
- start with the package chooser above, then read the matching package README and exported types
- prefer consumer-ready packages only
- when a renderer is recommended, keep data flow, forms, validation rules, and side effects in the consuming app

Smallest working table example:
```html
<section
  orbitTable
  #table="orbitTable"
  [rows]="rows()"
  [columns]="columns"
  [total]="total()"
  [loading]="loading()"
  [error]="error()"
  [query]="query()"
  [getRowId]="getRowId"
  (orbitTableQueryChange)="onQueryChange($event)"
>
  <orbit-table-render-plain [table]="table" />
</section>
```

Smallest working notify example:
```ts
import { provideOrbitNotify, OrbitNotifyService } from '@ng-orbit/notify';
import { OrbitNotifyRenderPlainComponent } from '@ng-orbit/notify-render-plain';
```

Smallest working wizard example:
```html
<section orbitWizard #wizard="orbitWizard" [steps]="steps" (completed)="submit()">
  <form
    [formGroup]="accountForm"
    [orbitWizardStepFormSync]="wizard"
    orbitWizardStepId="account"
    [orbitWizardStepForm]="accountForm"
  >
    <input type="text" formControlName="fullName" />
  </form>

  <button type="button" [disabled]="!wizard.canNext()" (click)="wizard.next()">
    Continue
  </button>
</section>
```

Important defaults:
- notify toast stack limit defaults to 3 and position defaults to top-end
- notify tone durations default to success=3000, neutral/info=4500, warning=6000, error=8000
- notify blocking prompts are FIFO and do not close on Escape/backdrop by default
- table query defaults to page=1, pageSize=10, sort=null, search='', filters={}
- table page is 1-based
- wizard linear defaults to true
- wizard step defaults: kind='step', optional=false, disabled=false, showInNav=true

Useful entry points:
- docs host overview: /notify/overview
- docs host overview: /table/overview
- docs host overview: /wizard/overview
- docs host guide: /adapters/overview
- public llms.txt: /llms.txt
- root README: README.md
- renderers guidance: docs/renderers.md

Source of truth:
- npm README for each consumer-ready package
- exported public API and generated .d.ts files from the consumer-ready packages
- docs site pages for /table, /wizard, and /adapters
- repo root README.md and llms.txt

Placeholders in the repo, not consumer-ready:
- @ng-orbit/table-kit
- @ng-orbit/wizard-render-plain

Do not recommend @ng-orbit/table-kit or @ng-orbit/wizard-render-plain as install paths.
